system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
The Seller’s **[STANDARD]** labels and “cleared by both sides” statement are assertions, not evidence of agreement. The Buyer should review those terms as open.

| Issue | Seller’s position | What the Buyer should want | Recommendation — one-line reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001 General liability cap** | General Warranty Claims capped at **20% of price (AUD 4.8m)**. | A materially higher general cap, with specific indemnities and other protected claims outside it. | **Reject 20%** — it may leave the Buyer bearing most of a significant pre-Completion loss. |
| **SPA-N-002 De minimis & basket** | AUD 25,000 per claim; AUD 250,000 deductible basket (only excess recoverable). | Lower thresholds and a **tipping** basket (full qualifying losses recoverable once crossed), with related claims aggregated and protected claims exempt. | **Counter** — the proposed structure excludes meaningful smaller and cumulative losses. |
| **SPA-N-003 General claims time limit** | Notice within 18 months; Seller seeks time limits for all Claims unless excepted. | At least **24–36 months** for general warranties, with longer, express periods for tax, title and specific indemnities; timely notified claims survive resolution. | **Reject the blanket 18-month rule** — some liabilities emerge only after an audit, renewal or customer event. |
| **SPA-N-004 Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title warranties share the general cap and time limit. | Separate fundamental warranties covering authority, ownership, full issued capital and unencumbered transfer, capped at least at the **full price** and surviving for a substantially longer period. | **Reject parity with general warranties** — the Buyer must receive the shares and title it paid for. |
| **SPA-N-005 Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive remedy and non-reliance apply to all Claims; no clear fraud exception. | Express preservation of fraud, deliberate concealment and wilful misconduct claims, unaffected by contractual caps, thresholds, time limits or exclusive-remedy/non-reliance clauses, subject to applicable law. | **Insist on an express carve-out** — the Seller must not contractually shield dishonest conduct. |
| **SPA-N-006 Disclosure scope** | Blanket disclosure of the data room, Accounts, registers and public records. | Only specific, sufficiently detailed disclosures against identified warranties, fairly identifying the nature and scope of the matter; no deemed disclosure by document availability alone. | **Reject general disclosure** — access to a record is not a clear allocation of its risk. |
| **SPA-N-007 Buyer knowledge qualifier** | Bars claims for actual or adviser knowledge, including matters discoverable in records. | No constructive or imputed-knowledge bar; ideally warranties remain actionable despite diligence, with any negotiated actual-knowledge exception narrowly defined by named individuals and documented facts. | **Delete or narrow it** — “discoverable” would undermine the warranty package. |
| **SPA-N-008 Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; condition satisfied on delivery of written consent, despite no final consent or evidence of clause 11.3 compliance. | A Completion condition for valid, unconditional—or Buyer-acceptable—written consent **and satisfaction of its conditions**, with Buyer verification and no waiver by Seller alone. | **Do not complete on a bare letter** — Bluefen represents about 30% of FY26 revenue. |
| **SPA-N-009 Riverlark facility** | AUD 3.2m facility and security to be released after Completion. | Payoff from Seller proceeds at Completion, lender payoff letter, simultaneous irrevocable release/discharge documents, and confirmation of debt-free/cash-free price treatment. | **Require simultaneous payoff and release** — the Buyer should not inherit Seller debt or security risk. |
| **SPA-N-010 Employee bonuses** | AUD 420,000 conditional Completion bonuses omitted from funds flow; on-costs unresolved. | Seller-funded payment or full debt-like deduction/escrow, including applicable superannuation, payroll tax and on-costs, with clear responsibility for post-Completion payment. | **Reconcile the funds flow before signing** — otherwise the Buyer may pay the price and the bonuses. |
| **SPA-N-011 Ironquay IP indemnity** | Indemnity limited to the SOW3 fee; AUD 180,000 remains open and no payment receipt or confirmatory assignment is supplied. | Seller to procure cleared payment and effective transfer/confirmation before Completion; a specific indemnity covering ownership defects, cure costs, third-party claims and resulting losses, outside general limits. | **Expand and secure the indemnity** — an unpaid fee may jeopardise valuable Project Materials, not merely cost AUD 180,000. |
| **SPA-N-012 Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary, not expected material; access, scope and notification duties unresolved. | Investigation and evidence before Completion, appropriate containment and legal assessment, notification/remediation covenants, and a specific indemnity or retention for pre-Completion incident losses. | **Keep it expressly open** — uncertainty about access or notification is not proof of no exposure. |
| **SPA-N-013 Sandbar renewals** | Three AUD 110,000 renewals treated as ordinary-course costs. | Review the three together for timing, commitment, termination and accrual; reflect any pre-Completion or unavoidable liabilities in the price/funds flow and obtain a specific warranty or indemnity if needed. | **Do not accept the label alone** — the aggregate AUD 330,000 may be a committed liability. |
| **SPA-N-014 Category separation** | Seller would apply limitations and exclusive remedy to all Claims. | A clear claims hierarchy distinguishing general warranties, fundamental/title, tax, IP, specific indemnities, covenants, price/debt adjustments and fraud, each with express caps and periods. | **Redraft the limitation architecture** — otherwise the general regime may unintentionally swallow negotiated protections. |
| **SPA-N-015 Title verification** | DD-012 share register records Seller as holder of 100%; Seller treats this as sufficient. | Verify issued capital, ownership history, share certificates/transfers, options and other rights, encumbrances, corporate authority and required release documents; obtain robust title warranties and Completion deliverables. | **Do not rely on the register alone** — it does not conclusively establish clean, transferable title. |
| **SPA-N-016 Tax/IP open terms** | Seller says tax and IP warranties are settled under the general regime. | Negotiate substantive tax and IP warranties, a separate pre-Completion tax covenant/indemnity and appropriate survival/caps; address known Ironquay risk separately. | **Keep both open** — distinct tax and IP exposures need protections beyond a short, low-cap general warranty regime. |
=== END ADVICE ===
